Flow.description: F-15: When a Quote's Status changes to Accepted and Signed_SOF_Uploaded__c is true, creates a Draft Order with all fields copied from the Quote, then creates OrderItems from all QuoteLineItems. Sets Primary_Quote__c on the Opportunity and stamps Signed_SOF_Date__c on the Quote. SFDC-379 (27 Aug 2026): entry criteria changed from Signed_SOF_Uploaded__c IsChanged to Status = Accepted + Status IsChanged, so ticking the Signed SOF Uploaded checkbox on its own no longer creates an Order.

formulas.name: frmAmendmentReason
formulas.expression: CASE({!$Record.Amendment_Reason__c}, "Price Change", "Price_Change", "Quantity Change", "Quantity_Change", "Product Change", "Product_Change", "Transfer", "Site_Transfer", "BAN Change", "BAN_Change", NULL)

formulas.name: frmOrderType
formulas.expression: CASE({!var_opportunity.Order_Type__c}, "New", "New Service", "Change/Upsell", "Change/Upsell", "Churn", "Churn", "Partial Churn", "Partial Churn", "BAN Change", "BAN Change", "Change Order", "Change/Upsell", "Termination", "Churn", "Novation", "BAN Change", "Ramp", "New Service", "Renewal", "Renewal", "New Service")
